note: Fiji issues no national identity card yet: the Reserve Bank of Fiji's page for the programme says the Government is in the process of establishing a National Identity system (Cabinet approved it in June 2024) and that Fijians currently rely on several unintegrated IDs (voter cards, tax IDs, the passport); the draft NID Bill went to public consultation from 27 March 2026. Those other cards are left to the Fiji package.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of Fiji, National ID (NID)
sources.said: The Government of Fiji is in the process of establishing a National Identity (NID) system to provide all citizens and residents with a secure and unified form of identification. Currently, Fijians rely on multiple IDs (e.g., voter cards, tax IDs, passport, etc.) that are not integrated ... In June 2024 Cabinet gave approval to proceed with the National ID programme. ... conducting public consultation on the draft NID Bill commencing from 27 March 2026.
